_verification_note: Commands assert PROPERTIES of the migration/schema/test files this slice's own design contract requires (exact table/function/grant/revoke shape, exact negative-scope absences), not pinned literals like row/test counts. They are written to run once the files in scope exist -- they will all fail today (pre-implementation), which is expected and correct for an authoring-only packet. The two negative-proof test-name greps (cross-tenant / non-participant DM) are a coarse proxy for 'the negative-path tests exist', not a substitute for a human/reviewer actually reading chat-schema-invariants.test.ts's assertions -- codex review must verify the negative assertions actually check zero-row results, not just that a describe/it block with a matching name exists.

security_review.reason: Creates the first RLS boundary on tenant-scoped conversation content (chat_channels/chat_members/chat_messages) and the first person-scoped RLS GUC (app.person_id) in this codebase -- every prior RLS policy (0009_rls_policies_grants.sql) is tenant-scoped only. A permissive default or a mis-ORed club/dm policy is a cross-tenant or cross-person read of private conversation content, the most sensitive data class this schema introduces. Security round must specifically verify: FORCE RLS on all 3 tables, the two-policy-per-table OR structure does not accidentally admit rows neither policy intends, the WITH CHECK impersonation guard on chat_messages, and that app has zero mutation grant on any of the three tables.
